data.name: Frontier Forge
data.detailed_description:
A forgotten frontier calls for a hero—or a ruthless mercenary.

Frontier Forge is an open-world survival action RPG seamlessly blended with colony management mechanics. Arrive at a desperate, borderland settlement on the brink of collapse. To survive, you must gather resources, construct your fortress, and train a band of loyal mercenaries to defend the villagers against brutal bandit raids and ancient horrors lurking in the wilds.

Will you remain a simple mercenary for hire, or forge a legendary stronghold to unite the realm?

KEY FEATURES

  • Build and Manage Your Settlement

    Transform a battered camp into a thriving, self-sufficient war base. Construct workshops, fortresses, and housing. Recuit and assign workers to gather resources, craft high-tier gear, and keep your stronghold supplied for war.

  • Command in Large-Scale Battles

    Stand side-by-side with your troops in visceral third-person combat. Issue real-time orders to your warband, hold tactical chokepoints, and crush incoming bandit raids before they burn your town to the ground.

  • Visceral Third-Person Combat

    Master a skill-based combat system where preparation, positioning, and timing mean the difference between victory and death. Equip your mercenary with a vast arsenal of crafted weapons and heavy armor tailored to your playstyle.

  • Expansive Wilderness & Exploration

    Venture beyond the town borders into dangerous, uncharted territories. Discover hidden ruins, gather rare crafting ingredients, and eliminate deadly regional threats that endanger the frontier.

  • Deep Crafting and Progression

    Unlock advanced blueprints as your camp grows. Upgrade your gear, refine your combat skills, and develop your workers into master artisans capable of forging legendary war equipment.
